records.jp: うん。大丈夫だよ！　<CR>……てか、何かあったの？　何だか暗い顔してる
records.en_original: Sure! What's up? You look a little gloomy, did something happen?
records.en: Sure! What's up? You look a little gloomy, did something happen?

records.jp: 特にはありません。<CR>でも、少し相談したいことがあって……
records.en_original: Not particularly, but there was something I wanted to speak with you about.
records.en: Not particularly, but there was something I wanted to speak with you about.

records.jp: うん。私でいいなら相談に乗るよ
records.en_original: Sure, I'm all ears! I hope I can help.
records.en: Sure, I'm all ears! I hope I can help.

records.jp: ここなら落ち着いて話せるんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: Here seems like a good place to talk.
records.en: Here seems like a good place to talk.

records.jp: そうですね。立ち話をするより、座って話す方が<CR>落ち着いて話ができます
records.en_original: Yes, I'm sure our legs would get tired if we stood up for the whole conversation.
records.en: Yes, I'm sure our legs would get tired if we stood up for the whole conversation.

records.jp: あはは。そういう意味じゃないんだけど……<CR>ま、いっか……で、相談って？
records.en_original: Hahaha, that's not exactly what I meant, but... Anyways, what was it you wanted to ask me?
records.en: Hahaha, that's not exactly what I meant, but... Anyways, what was it you wanted to ask me?

records.jp: 実は、私もみなさんと親しくしたいんです。<CR>でも、何故か上手くできなくて……
records.en_original: I'd like to get to know everyone better, but I'm not having much luck...
records.en: I'd like to get to know everyone better, but I'm not having much luck...

records.jp: （詩さん、昔は怖い人だったって<CR>みんなに警戒されてるとこあるけど……）
records.en_original: (Everyone is a little wary of Uta after learning about who she used to be...)
records.en: (Everyone is a little wary of Uta-san after learning about who she used to be...)

records.jp: （やっぱ、気にしてたんだ……）
records.en_original: (Seems like she's been worrying about it...)
records.en: (Seems like she's been worrying about it...)

records.jp: うーん。私もここに来たばっかの頃は、<CR>ちょっと浮いてた気がするし……
records.en_original: Hmm, well I felt like a bit of an outsider when I first came here too.
records.en: Hmm, well I felt like a bit of an outsider when I first came here too.

records.jp: 一緒に過ごしてくうちに馴染んだ気がするんだ。<CR>だから詩さんもきっと──
records.en_original: But after spending a bit of time with everyone, I felt like I fit right in before I knew it. I'm sure you'll be able to—
records.en: But after spending time together, I felt like I fit right in. So I'm sure you will too, Uta-san—

records.jp: 私には、星崎さんの言葉がどのような意図の嘘<CR>なのかは、よく分かりません
records.en_original: I'm not sure why you are lying to me, Ao.
records.en: I'm not sure why you are lying to me, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: でも、それが嘘だということは、理解できます
records.en_original: But I know you are lying.
records.en: But I know you are lying.

records.jp: 「嘘」……かぁ……。<CR>そう言われちゃうと、ちょっとキツいかも
records.en_original: Lying, huh...? I guess when you put it that way, maybe I am.
records.en: Lying, huh...? I guess when you put it that way, maybe I am.

records.jp: 星崎さんは、自然に人と親しくなれる人です。<CR>でも、私は……違います
records.en_original: You're the kind of person that can get along with anyone, Ao. I'm...different.
records.en: You're the kind of person that can get along with anyone, Hoshizaki-san. I'm...different.

records.jp: だから、嘘だと言ってしまいました。<CR>……すみません。傷つけるつもりはなかったんです
records.en_original: That's why I said you were lying. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
records.en: That's why I said you were lying. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.

records.jp: いや、ちょっとびっくりしただけから！
records.en_original: No, I was just surprised, that's all!
records.en: No, I was just surprised, that's all!

records.jp: えっとつまり「詩さんも自然に馴染める」って<CR>とこを、嘘だって思ったってことだよね？
records.en_original: So in other words, you think that you'll never fit in?
records.en: So in other words, you thought the part about “Uta-san fitting in naturally” was a lie, right?

records.jp: はい。私には無理ですから
records.en_original: That's right. I believe it is impossible.
records.en: That's right. I believe it is impossible.

records.jp: ……うーん。じゃあさ、詩さんはどうして<CR>自分は「違う」って思ったの？
records.en_original: Hmm...why do you think you're so different, Uta?
records.en: Hmm...why do you think you're so different, Uta-san?

records.jp: 私は、人の気持ちを察することが苦手なようです。<CR>なにか間違った発言ばかりしてしまうようで……
records.en_original: I seem to have a hard time understanding other's feelings. I always manage to say the wrong thing...
records.en: I seem to have a hard time understanding other's feelings. I always manage to say the wrong thing...

records.jp: 多分……発言した言葉通りにしか、その言葉を<CR>理解できないからだと思います
records.en_original: Perhaps its because I only take people's words at face value.
records.en: Perhaps its because I only take people's words at face value.

records.jp: うーん……えっとさ、詩さん。<CR>「間違った発言」って、何だろ
records.en_original: Hmm... Uta? What exactly do you mean by "say the wrong thing"?
records.en: Hmm... Uta-san? What exactly do you mean by "say the wrong thing"?

records.jp: それは……今のように星崎さんの気持ちを<CR>傷つけてしまうような……
records.en_original: Like what I said just before. When I hurt your feelings.
records.en: Like... what I just did, hurting your feelings, Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: だーかーら、傷ついてないって。<CR>私も気楽な言い方しすぎてたし
records.en_original: I told you I'm fine! I shouldn't have said what I said anyways.
records.en: I told you I'm fine! I shouldn't have said what I said anyways.

records.jp: それに、詩さんの言うことが全部<CR>間違ってるなんて、私は思わないよ
records.en_original: More importantly, I don't think you're always saying the wrong thing, Uta.
records.en: More importantly, I don't think you're always saying the wrong thing, Uta-san.

records.jp: どうして、ですか？
records.en_original: You do?
records.en: You do?

records.jp: 誰だって相手の気持ちがいつも分かるわけないし。<CR>あとさ……思ったんだ
records.en_original: You can't expect to always understand how other people feel. And besides...
records.en: You can't expect to always understand how other people feel. And besides...

records.jp: 詩さんが丁寧に話してくれたおかげで、<CR>詩さんの気持ちが分かって嬉しかったぁ、って
records.en_original: It made me really happy that you felt comfortable enough to tell me how you felt.
records.en: Thanks to you explaining it so carefully, Uta-san,<CR>I was happy I could understand how you felt.

records.jp: 嬉しかった、ですか……？<CR>そんな風に、言ってくれるんですね
records.en_original: Happy? That's very kind of you to say.
records.en: Happy? That's very kind of you to say.

records.jp: うん。だから、みんなともしっかり話せば<CR>気持ちは通じると思うんだけど……
records.en_original: That's why if you just talk to everyone, they'll see how you feel. Though...
records.en: That's why if you just talk to everyone, they'll see how you feel. Though...

records.jp: 詩さんが困ってるのって、<CR>そういうことじゃないんだよね？
records.en_original: That's not the real problem, is it, Uta?
records.en: That's not the real problem, is it, Uta-san?

records.jp: はい。気持ちは目に見えないのに……何故<CR>みなさんは、会話の中から読み取れるんでしょう？
records.en_original: You are correct. I do not understand how are people able to understand other's feelings? You can't feel them, or see them.
records.en: You are correct. I do not understand how are people able to understand other's feelings? You can't feel them, or see them.

records.jp: そこそこ。感情なんて形がないものなのに、<CR>私、普通にみんなを分かってる気でいたんだよね
records.en_original: You're right. Emotions don't have a shape or anything. But even still, I think I understand how everyone feels.
records.en: You're right. Emotions don't have a shape or anything. But even still, I think I understand how everyone feels.

records.jp: 詩さんに言われて、思ったんだ。どうして<CR>それが当たり前、って思ってたんだろうって
records.en_original: I've never really thought about it much until you mentioned it.
records.en: What you said, Uta-san, made me wonder why I'd thought that was simply normal.

records.jp: だから……詩さんが悩んでも、当たり前だと思う。<CR>私だって、空気読めなかったり普通にするもん
records.en_original: That's why... I understand why you feel confused. Even I can't read the room from time to time.
records.en: So... I think it's only natural for you to struggle with it, Uta-san. Even I fail to read the room sometimes.

records.jp: じゃあ、どうすればいいのかっていうと……<CR>やっぱすぐには、いい考えって浮かばないなぁ……
records.en_original: As for what you should do to understand people better... I don't really have a good answer.
records.en: As for what you should do to understand people better... I don't really have a good answer.

records.jp: いえ……星崎さん、ありがとうございます。<CR>私のこんな話を聞いてくれて
records.en_original: That's okay. Thank you for listening, Ao.
records.en: That's okay. Thank you for listening, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: こんな風に悩んでいるのは私だけ……<CR>私がおかしいのだとばかり思っていました
records.en_original: I thought that I was the only one who had this problem. And that because of that I was strange.
records.en: I thought that I was the only one who had this problem. And that because of that I was strange.

records.jp: そして過去の私は、自分を孤独に追いやり、<CR>罪を犯したのでしょう
records.en_original: I wonder if the past me did all of those things because she was lonely.
records.en: I wonder if the past me did all of those things because she was lonely.

records.jp: でも、それは今の詩さんじゃないよ！<CR>だからさ、一緒に考えようよ
records.en_original: You're not that person anymore, Uta! Come on, we'll think of something together.
records.en: You're not that person anymore, Uta-san! Come on, we'll think of something together.

records.jp: 一緒に、ですか？<CR>でも、どうしてそこまで……？
records.en_original: Together? Why would you go so far for me?
records.en: Together? Why would you go so far for me?

records.jp: うーん。<CR>詩さんと友達になりたいから、かな
records.en_original: Hmm. I guess I just want to be friends with you, Uta.
records.en: Hmm. I guess I just want to be friends with you, Uta-san.

records.jp: 私と……友達に……<CR>何故なのか理解できませんが、嬉しいです
records.en_original: Friends...with me...? I'm not sure I understand, but I feel happy.
records.en: Friends...with me...? I'm not sure I understand, but I feel happy.

records.jp: 詩さん。私、もうちょっと考えてみるね！
records.en_original: I'll think about it some more, Uta!
records.en: I'll think about it some more, Uta-san!
